items.title: What Does AT&T Stock Do To Your Money When The Market Falls?
items.summary: AT&T (T) is up 4.4% over the last five trading days, while the S&P 500 is down 1.1%. Strength in a weak tape pulls money in. That five-day move is not the question. The question is what holding AT&T does to your money when the market moves, because over the past year it has tended to go the other way.

items.title: VF Corporation Cut Its Dividend 82%. Five Historical Cases Show What Could Happen Next
items.summary: When VF Corporation slashed its dividend by 82%, it joined a club of corporate giants whose payout cuts either marked a painful floor or the start of a longer collapse. Five historical cases reveal the two metrics that actually separated the recoveries from the disasters.

items.title: AT&T Teams Up With LifeMD for Virtual Health Care: Can it Aid Shares?
items.summary: T expands customer benefits with complimentary LifeMD memberships, offering virtual care, prescriptions and pharmacy services.

items.title: Tutor Perini's $334M Cash Flow Sets a Record: Can Momentum Last?
items.summary: Record first-half cash flow, rising revenues and a $19.9B backlog bolster TPC, though 2026 cash flow is set to trail last year's peak.

items.title: 2 Cash-Producing Stocks for Long-Term Investors and 1 We Question
items.summary: While strong cash flow is a key indicator of stability, it doesn’t always translate to superior returns. Some cash-heavy businesses struggle with inefficient spending, slowing demand, or weak competitive positioning.

items.title: Is Comcast Stock Cheap Or Just Shrinking?
items.summary: Comcast (CMCSA) generated free cash over the past twelve months worth 20.1% of its market value. The median S&P 500 company manages 4.4%. Part of that gap is Comcast's debt. The rest means one of two things: the market has made a mistake, or the cash is about to get smaller. Comcast keeps losing broadband customers, and that is the market's answer.

items.title: AST SpaceMobile vs. Redwire: Which Space Infrastructure Stock Is a Better Buy in 2026?
items.summary: Both burn cash heavily, but one trades at a large valuation premium, a gap that may or may not be justified by growth potential.

items.title: Can Verizon's 6G Acceleration Initiatives and AI Trials Drive Growth?
items.summary: VZ is advancing 6G with AI-native networks, real-world sensing trials and smart technologies, targeting the 2028 Olympics as a key test.
